item.content:encoded:
"Everything is permanent, you understand. Even I cannot undo an edit once it is made. You can change things back, but there is always a place, somewhere, where everything remains. The world I made when I changed that battle is still there."

I think the implication isn't so much that he makes a new universe every time he changes things as much as every time he changes something, and then tries to unchange it. He can bring the world back to how it was, but the world that he created through the change just gets set aside as an alternate universe. I read this as meaning that the universe he's tied to, the Foundation-verse, is sort of the primary universe, and every time he changes something in it, the universe that was gets set aside and creates an alternate timeline, making it sort of the inverse of what you're saying. It wasn't him changing the battle that created the University-verse, it was him undoing that edit.

As such I read his motives thusly. He wants to help this universe, the Foundation-verse, but his first attempt to do so, and his backtracking thereafter, led to the University-verse. After this mistake I presume him to have become more careful with his edits, to prevent such a scenario from happening again, but that one edit has started bleeding through into the primary universe, and he's scrambling to fix it because it was his fault to begin with.

item.content:encoded:
So, when the Intruder changed that first battle, he created the University-verse. And now there is nothing he can do about it because any changes he makes just create another parrallel universe. So in this short snippet he has created 3 new universe, one where Jackson's assassin is caught by a mob, one where he is caught by Jackson's friends, and one where the pistols misfire. If he is spending all this effort to un-do the damage of just one change, shouldn't he be trying harder to minimize the propagtion of parallel realities he keeps spinning off?

Don't mind me, over-analyzing the quirks of time travel is sort of a hobby. It's a good story and I'm interested in seeing where it goes next.
